title: Principal architect at a cloud provider

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Appreciate the time. What's your team focused on this half?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: We're redesigning the inference rack for our next region. The open question is memory disaggregation.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Can you say more about what disaggregation would solve for you?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Our KV cache hit rates fall off a cliff above a million tokens of context, and stranded DRAM on CPU nodes sits around forty percent idle.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Forty percent idle is a lot. How are you thinking about solving it?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: We're prototyping CXL 3.0 switches internally, but the silicon isn't mature and our timeline is eighteen months.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: What would make an external option worth evaluating against building in house?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Proof on p99 tail latency under mixed load. Average latency numbers don't mean anything to us.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Understood. Who owns the build versus buy decision?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: My VP of infrastructure, but she'll follow the recommendation from my architecture review.
